script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

Title: ECHOES OF US

INT. ECHOES OF US - CONFERENCE ROOM

A modern, open-concept office space, filled with employees working on laptops, chatting in small groups or alone at desks.

JESS (30s, confident), a Manager, sits at the head of the long conference table, addressing her team of five.

JESS
Good morning, team! I hope you're all ready for a productive day. Let's begin with our weekly check-ins. I'd like to go around the table and hear about each of your projects, what's going well, and where we can improve. Let's start with you, MIKE.

MIKE (30s, anxious), a Software Engineer, looks up from his laptop.

MIKE
Hi, Jess. Well, I've been making solid progress on the XYZ project. We've got a working prototype and are in the process of gathering user feedback. The team's really pulling together, and I think we're on track for a successful launch.

Jess nods appreciatively.

JESS
Great to hear that, Mike. Next, we have our Designer, LUCY.

LUCY (20s, ambitious), a Designer, steps forward.

LUCY
Hey, Jess. So, the UI redesign for the ABC app is coming along well. Users are really responding to the new look and feel, and we've seen a significant increase in engagement. I've also been working on developing some brand guidelines for the company – I think they'll really help us maintain a consistent visual identity.

Jess smiles.

JESS
Excellent, Lucy. Next, we have our Marketing Coordinator, ANNA.

ANNA (20s, determined), a Marketing Coordinator, stands up.

ANNA
Hi, Jess. I've been focusing on our social media strategy, and we've seen some impressive growth in our followings and engagement rates. I've also been working on a content calendar to keep our messaging consistent and on-brand.

Jess nods.

JESS
Sounds like a solid plan, Anna. Next up, we have our Content Writer, OLIVIA.

OLIVIA (25s, creative), a Content Writer, sits up straight.

OLIVIA
Hey, Jess. I've been working on some new blog posts for the website, as well as some email campaigns. I've also been collaborating with the design team to create some infographics and visual content to accompany our written pieces.

Jess smiles.

JESS
Fantastic, Olivia. And finally, we have our Project Manager, CHRIS.

CHRIS (35s, organized), a Project Manager, stands up.

CHRIS
Morning, Jess. Things are moving along smoothly with our current projects. We've got a couple of upcoming deadlines, but I'm confident that we'll meet them all. I've also been working on implementing some new project management tools to help us stay more efficient and organized as a team.

Jess looks around the table, satisfied.

JESS
Great work, everyone. Keep up the good work, and let's make today another productive day here at Echoes of Us.

As the team disperses, Mike approaches Jess.

MIKE
Jess, can I talk to you for a minute?

Jess nods and follows Mike out of the conference room.

INT. ECHOES OF US - JESS'S OFFICE

Mike closes the door behind him and sits down across from Jess.

MIKE
(whispers) I don't know if I'm in the right place here, Jess. I feel like I'm not really contributing as much as I could be. I was hoping we could discuss some ways I could take on more responsibility and maybe even a promotion.

Jess looks thoughtful.

JESS
Mike, I appreciate your initiative and ambition. I do think you have a lot to offer this team and the company as a whole. However, I'd like to see you take on some more leadership roles within your current projects. Have you thought about taking the lead on a project, or perhaps mentoring someone new to the team?

MIKE
I hadn't considered that, but I think that could be a great opportunity for me. I'd be happy to take on more responsibilities and help out in any way I can.

Jess smiles.

JESS
That's the spirit, Mike. I believe in you, and I know you'll make a valuable contribution as a leader on our team. Let's discuss some specific projects and opportunities for you to take on more responsibility when we have a moment.

Mike looks relieved and grateful.

MIKE
Thank you, Jess. I really appreciate your support.

Jess nods.

JESS
You're welcome, Mike. Now, let's get back to work and make today a great day for Echoes of Us.

INT. ECHOES OF US - OPEN FLOOR

As the day goes on, the team members work together, collaborating and supporting each other, all contributing to the success of Echoes of Us.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
